name: brand-kit-studio
description: Turn a brand name, tagline and logo into a matching set of assets: favicon.ico and PNG icons with site.webmanifest and <head> tags, app icons, a social avatar, Open Graph / X / Xiaohongshu images, and WeChat, X, LinkedIn and YouTube banners. Colours are suggested from the logo; preview and tweak every asset in the side panel, and get editable SVG templates. Runs locally; no API keys.

description_i18n.en: Turn a brand name, tagline and logo into a matching set of assets: favicon.ico and PNG icons with site.webmanifest and <head> tags, app icons, a social avatar, Open Graph / X / Xiaohongshu images, and WeChat, X, LinkedIn and YouTube banners. Colours are suggested from the logo; preview and tweak every asset in the side panel, and get editable SVG templates. Runs locally; no API keys.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 输入品牌名、标语和 logo，一次生成风格统一的整套素材：favicon.ico 和各尺寸 PNG 图标（含 site.webmanifest 与网页 <head> 代码）、App 图标、社媒头像、链接分享图、X/小红书配图，以及公众号、X、LinkedIn、YouTube 横幅。品牌色可从 logo 自动提取；在侧栏预览并逐个调整，同时导出可编辑的 SVG 模板。全部本地处理，无需 API 密钥。

fontPath.title: 中文字体文件（可选）
fontPath.description: 可选。素材文字使用的字体文件（.ttf/.otf/.ttc）完整路径。默认自动查找系统中文字体（macOS: 苹方 / 冬青黑体，Windows: 微软雅黑，Linux: Noto Sans CJK）。
